nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum

avis.texte: I bought this eye cream because of all the good reviews. My first time using is it, it came out a dark orange color. It went on my skin extremely orange. I assumed this was the correct color of the product because the color was similar to the bottle. It was extremely hard to cover with makeup so I decided to look up the reviews after a couple days of use and see what was up. Apparently the cream is white.... I don't know if I got a bad one but after reading the reviews it seems like a lot of people are getting bad products. I wanted to elevate my skincare routine so I splurged on some new products. This is the most I have ever spent on an eye cream and I only used it 4 times and I am going to have to throw it away. Almost $70 down the trash. I am so disappointed.
I have not had this very long. My skin is soft but, still have the problem. I do not know if I would recommend this to others. You never know it might work for them.

I have dry-combination skin and this irritated my eye area when the weather was dry. Didn't notice any changes besides the orange tint that the cream has covers up the dark circles slightly. The ingredients felt a bit too strong for my eye area.
This is a must if you have dark bags under your skin. I little goes a LONG way. I do feel like it's turning my finger nails a tint of yellow which I'm not sure why.

I am 32 and I started to see "crows feet" forming on the edge of my eyelid and I said OH H*ll NOOOOO! Lol I have been using it a month and i am glad to inform you no more signs of crows feet! I think others are reviewing the wrong product because let me tell you this thing works!
My budget for an eye cream was half what I paid, but this eye serum is so worth it.

I know a lot of people will say eye cream is not necessary but I love using eye cream especially when it has added benefits. This eye cream in particular helps to camouflage my dark under eyes. In addition it gives me a flawless base for my makeup application. I have mid thirties skin and my under eyes are becoming more thin with fine lines. Having a hydrating base truly makes the difference!

I bought this because the store didn't have the color correcting eye serum I wanted so I took a chance. It just ok - doesn't seem to color correct as well as other brand I started using. It's moisturizing, but not as much as I thought it would be. it's ok, but I'll go back to Sunday Riley's color corrector eye serum.

avis.titre: I would probably buy this again!
avis.texte: I used the Kiels Serum every night. I honestly didn't see any difference in dark circles or puffiness BUT, I loved the way the serum felt on my face. It spread easily and didn't feel heavy or pasty. It absorbed quickly and left my skin feeling soft and smooth.

After officially using this for a few months now i can say it works so well!! I visibly have brighter undereyes and I couldn't be more happy. Finally found my holy grail of eye creams. Very happy with this product

Purchased this to reduce dark circles and it did the total opposite after the first use. Skin was became very irritated and burned my skin off making it hard to even close my eyes. Skin irritated for 8 days and the only reason it started to heal was due to my esthetician. She provided me with treatment to help reduce the pain that I was in. Thank God I didn't have to go yo the doctor.

I'm not a huge eye cream or eye serum believer. That said, I do think this helped brighten my eye area a little bit! Although, that may just be my mind trying to find a positive. It goes on smoothly though, doesn't smell and absorbs quickly! So that's lovely anyway 😊

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again.
avis.texte: I am so happy to see Kiehl's line being carried in my local Ulta! I love all their products.
I've tried lots of eye creams but this beats them all for my mature undereyes. I have repurchased 3 times now and will continue
I love vitamin c products and this is the first one l've used specially for my eyes. I find that it goes well under light makeup and I like the texture of the serum.
Very beautiful and brightening. I would recommend this product!
I love how bright it made my under eyes. I will def repurchase.

I have really dark circles under my eyes, I've tried multiple different products but didn't see much difference. I used this one for a week and definitely see a difference! So happy, couldn't recommend this enough
I love the texture and feel of this vitamin C. It is wonderfully smooth and gentle on the skin but still very effective.

avis.titre: This product will be my daily routine
avis.texte: I love it after using 1 week. My dark circle is brighter and better day by day. This product is work well on me. Highly recommend!!

Kiehl's line-reducing and dark circle-diminishing vitamin C eye serum exceeded my expectations. It has a very velvety texture that immediately improves the texture of your skin after applying. It also goes well under makeup. The appearance of the dark circles has improved tremendously over the last 3 weeks since I started using this serum. It also has not a very typical serum texture. It resembles more of a luxurious cream - rich, velvety and silky.

I use this eye cream in the mornings under my makeup and I love the consistency. Very lightweight and silicone texture, a light orange color but it disappears when you pat it in. I love that it comes in a pump bottle, very sanitary. I have experienced no irritation when using this around my eyes, it's very gentle. I would recommend this product if you are looking for a vitamin C eye cream. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

Cream feels very luxurious when applying. Has a nice, satin feel. Makes my tired eyes feel and look refreshed! Works great under makeup, leaves no residue or unpleasant effects. Skin feels soft, eyes look brighter and less tired!
I applied to my eyes and it's very smooth and silky. It glides on and absorbed well. My eyes felt hydrated and I'm starting to see less visible lines.

Loved this eye cream! No greasy feel, no burning eyes, just smooth silicone like texture. Definitely reduced the crows feet, I didn't see much difference in dark circles though. Also looks great under makeup, not pilling like alot of eye serums. I would definitely recommend this

I've been using the Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum for about three weekes now, and I'm quite happy with the results. I noticed a reduction in the darkness of my under-eye circles after just a few weeks of consistent use, which was a pleasant surprise. The serum has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly into the skin, and it doesn't leave any greasy residue, which is a huge plus for me. The vitamin C in the serum seems to brighten my skin, and I've noticed a slight improvement in the overall texture around my eyes. My skin feels smoother, and the fine lines appear less prominent. I also appreciate that it doesn't have a strong scent, which is often an issue with other eye products I've tried. However, it's not a miracle worker. If you have very pronounced dark circles or deep-set wrinkles, it might take longer to see significant improvements. Also, the price point is on the higher side, which could be a consideration for some people. Overall, I would recommend this product to anyone looking to brighten their under-eye area and reduce the appearance of dark circles and fine lines. It's a solid product that delivers on its promises, as long as you have realistic expectations.
This is an amazing product for your eyes. This is an amazing cream that helps reduce dark circles and makes you look more awake.

I was surprised by the color and texture, but ended up really liking this serum. It felt less oily on my skin than most others I've tried. It goes on easily and I never felt like I had to wait before continuing my routine or putting on makeup. My only wish is that for the price, there was a bit more product included. Overall a really nice serum that I've enjoyed adding to my skincare routine.

I recently started using this eye cream and was a little nervous because I am sensitive to vitamin C. However, this has been extremely gentle and goes on very smooth. A little goes a long way. I do notice my eyes look a little less "haggard" when I use it but I can't tell of its because my under eyes look a little more smooth or a little less dark. There wasn't complete removal of wrinkles or dark circles but it was subtly and I think with continued use that I may see an overall improvement!
I added this to my daytime routine before my moisturizer. It sits well under my make-up.

I noticed some definite lightening under the eye area in addtion to other eye products feeling more potent and penetrating better after using this one product. I felt that the creamier texture stayed in place better and did more than many other very thin serums do.

avis.titre: Kiels Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vit C Eye Serum
avis.texte: I recieved a sample of Kiels Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum i exchange for my honest review. I found this serum slighly irritaing and stung a bit at first around my eye area. Despite the intial redness, the serum did reduce the dark circles arounf my eyes.. I found that using a tiny bit worked better for me.
I don't think I noticed any difference from the time I received this as a gift. But it does feel nice under the eyes which is really nice! But I wouldn't say it made my dark circles any less visible!

avis.titre: LOVE THIS AND WOULD BUY AGAIN
avis.texte: This vitamin c serum has a lightweight, gel-like texture that absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue. I applied in the morning and evening, gently patting it around the eye area with my ring finger. I would say it was well-tolerated by sensitive skin around the eyes. Price: Kiehl's products can be on the pricier side. Results May Vary: Individual results can differ; some might not see immediate improvements. (My mom "borrowed" it and used it for a week and saw some major improvements, I don't think i'll be getting it back) Summary: Kiehl's Vitamin C Eye Serum is a solid choice if you're looking for an eye product that combines brightening and hydrating benefits. Its formulation with Vitamin C and hyaluronic acid can address common concerns like dark circles and fine lines. However, as with any skincare product, results may vary, and it may be worth trying a sample first if possible.

I really like this eye cream. I've tried several vitamin c based eye creams and serums in the past and was frustrated with the lack of long lasting hydration. This cream however is extremely hydrating without feeling heavy on skin. I've seen a slight improvement in my dark circles but what really impressed me was how the fine lines around my eyes were less noticeable and it also had somewhat of a "de puffing" effect. The bottle is small like most eye treatments but a little goes a long way…like a LONG way making this a very cost effective product.

Kiehl's kindly sent me this eye serum for free in exchange for my honest review. Firstly, I would agree in saying that this product is more like a cream texture than a serum. That being said, it is pretty lightweight and absorbs nicely for me, someone with oily skin. I feel like I have had some improvement with fine lines but I haven't seen any major differences in my dark circles yet. I'll continue observing it until I finish the product.

I have been using this product for about two week a notice very little improvement but I believe over the time will notice more the consistency is rich and thick smells like medicine and a little goes a long way i was expecting to see more improvements event after using it 2x a day

After using this product for the last couple of weeks, I have learned to like it more than I did at first. My first thought was that it felt oily, but after thoroughly rubbing it in and wearing throughout the day and night, it didn't seem to bother me. Actually made the eye area quite soft and smooth. This does take time to take effect. It's not like some products that will firm that area right away. No allergic reactions and I have pretty sensitive skin.

avis.titre: An extremely rich and moisturizing eye cream
avis.texte: I use this product twice a day. I am really impressed with the results. This eye cream is very decadent and deeply moisturizes my eye area.

avis.titre: I am really impressed after trying this eye cream
avis.texte: I suffer from dark under eye circles and was rather impressed after trying this eye cream. In the short amount of time that I have been using this, I have seen rapid results. The vitamin c truly helps to lighten dark circles as well as de puff and hydrate the eye area. After using this product not only do I see a decrease in dark circles but my eye area feels real good and fine lines and wrinkles have been smoothed out. This is a product I would highly recommend to anyone who wants to diminish dark circles and add hydration to the eye area.

I received this serum for free in exchange for my honest review. I like the product very much. I feel the vitamin C is helpful in making my undereye look smoother and brighter. I notice a slight warming sensation when I apply the serum, and it actually has a mattifying effect. The serum is thick, more like a cream. I look forward to seeing continued improvement over time!
I really like this serum. It absorbs well and is not greasy.I feel like there has been a slight reduction in dark undergoes, and my skin is looking really healthy and bright. Good price point too!

I've been using this product for about a month now. The texture of this serum is thicker than I expected - it feels more like a cream. That's not a bad thing, just something to note. It applies smoothly and feels nice on the skin, and I haven't had issues wearing makeup over it. The ingredients are great, and my undereyes definitely feel a little more plump and hydrated, but due to the nature of the product, I don't feel like I can make sweeping claims about effectiveness quite yet, as products like this take a few months to see maximum results. One thing I've noticed is that the light peachy/orange color combined with the thicker texture does seem to subtly brighten under my eyes immediately, which is nice. I'm going to keep using it.

I tried this product for a few weeks to give it a chance. I really wanted to like it to like it, and I did really ebony how well it moisturized but I didn't feel like it did anything for dark circles which was disappointing.

avis.titre: Smoothing but heavier than a serum
avis.texte: I like that this eye serum has great proven ingredients for brightening and smoothing and feel like the claims would e accurate for someone with dark circles due to discolored skin. Unfortunately for me, my circles are due to thinner, more translucent skin around my eyes so if that is also the case for you, this may not be the best choice. The serum was definitely smoothing and felt relatively hydrating but I wouldn't consider this an eye serum. To me, it's closer to a thinner cream or a gel cream and not as lightweight as I'd hoped. It isn't a bad product, just not the ideal one for my needs. If you prefer a slightly lighter eye cream that works for discolored underlies and smooths lines, this may be a good option!

I received this product as a free sample and was determined to test it to see if it actually works. For ten days, I used this product under only one eye. I usually remembered to apply it twice daily as instructed. The puffiness under that eye diminished significantly. So I stopped my experiment and have been using it under both eyes. I am very pleased with this product!
I started seeing results right away from this eye cream. I used in morning and at night. It helped brighten my under eyes and my dark circles. Can't wait to see what it does long term!

Very impressed with the brightening and hydrating effects of this serum! It is unlike other eye serums I have tried, as it is thicker in consistency than most I've used in the past. Think "pillowy". Despite its thickness, it never once clashed with the other products in my routine. I have sensitive skin around my eyes, and found no irritation as I've been incorporating this into my skincare every night. It's been a month and I'm happy with my results!!! I would definitely recommend this product, especially to anyone insecure about their dark under-eye circles.

This serum is creamy and rich, but still lightweight and easy to absorb. After using this product for one month, my undereye area appears smoother and less puffy. The skin tone also seems a bit brighter, though it's not a huge difference. Besides that, I also don't see any noticeable improvement in the dryness of the skin. The bottle is small and a bit pricy in my opinion. The pump helps to get the right amount of product easily.
Used morning and night for 2 weeks and could definitely tell a difference.

I'm on the fence with this product. I didn't notice any change in my under eye dark circles, but don't usually anyway. It's thick, soaks in well, and makes me feel moisturized. If my face gets wet (crying, in the pool, etc) it does sting my eyes. A little goes a long way, like a half a pump is good for both eyes. It feels nice going on and would recommend if in your usual budget. I don't think it'd be worth it though if you're splurging.
I tried thus product for the last couple weeks, and my dark circles are diminishing. I highly recommend!!!
I use in my nightly face routine. Does not leave an oily feeling on face. Helped my skin look better. Which made me feel better about how my eyes looked.

I have noticed an improvement in my fine lines after using this product daily. I really like the consistency and find that it goes on super smooth under my moisturizer and makeup. It doesn't have any cooling effect, but I feel woken up after applying.
I'm still on the fence. It's great at hydration but it has a primer silicone feel to it and I'm not sure it soaks into my skin like I want.

I've tried so many under eye treatments and none have worked for me until I met this product. The texture is so smooth so it does not interfere with any under eye concealer you put on top of it, however after a week or so of using this product I no longer needed under eye concealer. It makes my previously dark circles look bright, hydrated and dewy. The only thing I will say to be careful with is dosage if you have sensitive skin. I started using 2x per day per product instructions but this product is very strong so it did dry my skin. Stepping back to 1x per day is perfect for me. Highly recommend this product!

Kiehl's Vitamin C Serum is clearly the best.It significantly reduced fine lines and wrinkles and made my skin smoother and brighter in ways that appear nearly impossible. It quickly penetrates into the skin, and I can apply moisturizer within only two minutes. I was wondering if I am imagining the difference until I met my friend whom I didn't see for a year. She asked me if I have done anything to improve the skin. After that visit, she also started to use Kiehl's Vitamin C serum. I am definitely buying more !

I was excited to try this because I've been into skincare for a couple of years now. I noticed I was starting to get dark circles due to exhaustion and stress. This product has helped the puffiness and color. Although it's been a few weeks of trying out the product I do see a difference. I think the more religiously I use it the more effective it is. Overall I like the product and will continue to add this into my skincare routine. I would recommend this to a family or friend, reason of 4 stars is because the more time I give it I will see better results. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

This vitamin C under eye serum is very hydrating and leaves my delicate skin area feeling very moisturized. It's thick so I use it at night and my fine lines seem less prominent in the morning. Regarding dark circles, I haven't noticed a drastic change but I do feel it has brightened up the area. I will keep using it and hope to see a bigger dfference after 6 weeks of use.
This has definitely improved my under eye appearance! Its a light product and works wonders

I've been using this product every night for about a month now. I was so excited to try it out as fine lines and dark spots have been a big concern of mine lately as I am getting older. The product goes on smooth and is not oily. It also does not have a scent which I appreciate. I have yet to see any significant results, but I am hopeful that with continued use I will begin to see my fine lines and dark circles diminish. I plan on continuing to use the bottle until its entirety and then I'll purchase again if start seeing any results.

avis.titre: This eyes serum does work but it takes time to see a result!
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange of ny honest review. This eyes serum is yellow tinted due to vutamin C included. The texture is creamy thick but glide smoothly on my skin. It doesn't absorb fast because the cream is thick even though it say serum but it mostly like cream texture. It take time to see a little change to my under eyes dark circle help skin brightening a little day by day and remember to use sunscreen when go outside because it has vitamin C. I'll continue use this eyes serum because it last forever just need to use a pea side amount everytime.

avis.titre: This is a must have in my routine!
avis.texte: This is small but mighty! I only have to use a little each time, so it lasts really well. The smell is pretty neutral, which I appreciate, and I'm seeing noticeable differences in the wrinkles under my eyes.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: The first thing I noticed about this eye serum is the smell, which I'm not a fan of 😔, but luckily it's not too close to my nose. The formula is quite thick, so I only need to use about half a pump each time. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any residue or sticky feeling, which I appreciate. The instructions suggest using it morning and night, but because it's a strong Vitamin C product, I'm sticking to using it only in my nighttime routine. It feels gentle enough and I haven't experienced any irritation, so I'm hopeful it will help with my dark circles over time.

I've used this for the last six weeks or so every single night under my eyes. I love the way it feels, it's very moisturizing and it's still there when I wake up. I have not seen much as far as dark circle diminishing or line-reducing and using anything with vitamin c is about the long game, so it's hard to tell what long term effects this product will have with continued use. Also, it only takes a small amount, so I feel like the product will last quite a while, but like many high end products you can't see when it's almost empty!
This product texture is light and air. I have used it on other parts of my face besides under my eyes. It works really really well at keeping my skin healthy. I definitely recommend.

avis.titre: I received this item for free for a review
avis.texte: I love this product. I use it everyday and my eye bags look much better. The cream leaves skin very soft. Without a doubt when I run out, I will buy another one.

Very. impressive eye serum! I have been using this product every morning and night for 2 weeks and definitely have noticed visible positive results! I frequently suffer from puffiness and tired looking eyes along with dark circles. I was, of course, skeptical as I have tried many products with little or at best, minimal good results. I found this serum to be effective at minimizing the puffiness and dark circles, making me look less tired. Eyes look brighter...when looking at me, the focus actually goes to my actual eyes vs my dark circles. It is very lightweight, creamy and hydrating but not greasy. Absorbs fairly quickly. Makeup can be applied over it, although I did not put makeup over it because it looks pretty good without it! There is virtually no scent at all. It also seems to somewhat smooth out fine lines. There was absolutely no irritation, and it is invisible on the skin. A little goes a long way so you only need a very small amount. Is packaged in a bottle with a convenient little pump which I find helps to easily take out only a small amount, minimizing waste. I am happy with this product, lives up to the Kiehls good name. Recommended for anyone who is looking to improve their under-eye area and to smooth out fine lines. I will continue to use!

avis.titre: Works pretty ok but doesn't completely clear it up
avis.texte: This is pretty good. It took me sometime to notice a difference but I feel my dark circles are a little lighter. But i dont feel it completely took it away

I was really excited to receive this product to test, but unfortunately it stings a little so it is uncomfortable. I have very sensitive skin, so maybe that is why and I just need to give it some time for my skin to adjust. It did not give me a rash, so I may continue to use it every couple of days.
I use it every other night and I see a slight difference. I need to use it every night and be more consistent to see if I will see more of a difference. So far so good though
After using this product for the last few weeks I'm in love!! This helps keep my under eyes hydrated and dark circles at bay. Just look at my before and after pics
I've been using it for the past 3 weeks and OMG it feels very nice, applies easy smells great and mostly my underrated are hydrate! I will continue using it

Really great texture and seems to help with short term brightness. I don't know about long term results, but it does help plump up my eye area without having any sticky residue left behind. Also doesn't irritate the eye area.

#### Overview The Powerful-Strength Line-Reducing & Dark Circle-Diminishing Vitamin C Eye Serum is designed to target common concerns around the delicate eye area, such as fine lines, dark circles, and puffiness. Infused with potent ingredients, this serum aims to brighten and rejuvenate the skin, making it a popular choice among skincare enthusiasts. #### Key Ingredients 1. **Vitamin C (L-ascorbic acid)**: Known for its brightening properties, Vitamin C helps to reduce the appearance of dark circles and improve overall skin tone. 2. **Hyaluronic Acid**: This ingredient provides hydration, plumping the skin and minimizing the appearance of fine lines. 3. **Peptides**: These help to stimulate collagen production, enhancing skin elasticity and firmness. 4. **Caffeine**: Often used to reduce puffiness, caffeine can help constrict blood vessels and diminish swelling. #### Texture & Application The serum has a lightweight, gel-like consistency that absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving a greasy residue. A small amount goes a long way, making it easy to apply both morning and night. The dropper applicator allows for precise dispensing, ensuring you use just the right amount. #### Efficacy Users have reported noticeable improvements in the appearance of dark circles and fine lines after consistent use. Many appreciate the immediate brightening effect and the long-term benefits of reduced puffiness. The hydrating properties of hyaluronic acid also contribute to a smoother tex

avis.titre: Kiehls Powerful Dark Circle Reducing Vita C Eye Serum, WORKS
avis.texte: This really is a powerful under eye cream, it does exactly as it says in the product description, took me about 2 weeks to really see a big difference but a difference none the less. This is unscented, and melts into your skin like butter, none sticky, greasy, or oily. A little goes a long way, so you do you get your money's worth, and it's affordable for those of us on a budget. I totally recommend this Kiehls Powerful-Strength Dark Circle under eye cream to everyone who's needing results and fast! Thanks for reading!

This product is the first time I've used a Vitamin C eye cream, so I can't compare it to other Vitamin C eye creams. However, the cream is nice and smooth, making it easy to apply in the delicate eye area. The bottle has a pump to help you control the amount that you dispense & you don't need very much to apply.As for its effectiveness, I can't say that it's making more of a difference than my facial moisturizer at this time. I like that the creaminess of it isn't too thick. It absorbs well into the skin and feels light. I REALLY, REALLY like the fact that it's paraben free and fragrance free. Cleaner products are so important, so this is a nice benefit of this product. Another benefit of this product is that it includes hyaluronic acid. Although it mentions seeing results in 7 days, I will wait until I finish this bottle to determine if I'd purchase this product in the future. Therefore, I would also want to wait before recommending this product to friends or family. I did receive this product free for an honest review. Lastly, the bottle is airport carry-on size.

This product from kiels does magic. A small amount under each and around my etes changed everything in a week. Much more complexion and less dark spots under eyes. More refreshed and everyone has me telling me what i did. It truly works but need to be consistent on application and you will love you rejuvenated and fresh your eyes look. Definitely recommend

avis.titre: Great texture/feel, ineffective with dark circles.
avis.texte: I've used this product twice daily for two plus weeks, at this point. It really feels like a luxury product. The texture is smooth, and I've even forgone using primer under my eyes because I feel like this does a great job of smoothing/prepping the area. I haven't noticed any difference at all with dark circles. Fine lines are somewhat reduced and the area feels and looks soft and smooth. I extended the product out to go over some hyperpigmentation at my temples, and I didn't notice any lightening there, either. That said, I love the feel of it. If it were at a lower price price point, I'd use it to replace my regular under eye cream.

I have been using this serum for a few weeks now and my 40 year old eyes LOVE it! It has a velvety texture and deeply hydrates my eye area without greasiness or sensitivity. I can apply my makeup over top without issue which is a dark circle girly must! From Day 1 I saw instant hydration and then over time a noticeable brightening. This is my new favorite eye care product and will definitely be a staple in my skin care routine.

I have used this over a week now and I've noticed my dark circles have lightened up and the wrinkles around my eyes have softened. Thank you for sending this to me because I will probably continue to buy it.

I was initially hesitant to try Kiehl's Vitamin C Eye Serum because I have a known allergy to Vitamin C, and the skin around my eyes is particularly sensitive. However, I decided to give it a shot, and I'm so glad I did! This serum is incredibly emollient and feels luxuriously moisturizing on the skin. It absorbs well without leaving a greasy residue, and my under-eye area feels soft and hydrated all day. To my surprise, I experienced no irritation at all, which is a rarity for me with Vitamin C products. It's been a game-changer in my skincare routine, helping to smooth fine lines and brighten my eyes without any of the discomfort I usually associate with active ingredients like Vitamin C. If you have sensitive skin or are wary of trying Vitamin C products, this one is definitely worth considering!

This is a decent size eye cream. Comparable to other brands. The texture is cream like. Hydrating to the skin. It's easy to apply and soak into the skin. No sensitive at all. I feel like my under eye looks brighter and more alert. I look refreshed

avis.titre: Helps me look well rested even when I am not!
avis.texte: I don't normally use eye cream in my regular skincare routine so I was wanting to try this. Thank you Kiehl's for sending me this product for free so I could review it. The eye cream has a nice light creamy texture with a matte finish. It works well under makeup and was non-irritating for me. I like that is has a lot of actives. Not only does it have vitamin c and fragmented hyaluronic acid but also peptides - I keep hearing so much about how important they are to add to your routine. It's pretty concentrated - you only need very little. While it did brighten up my eye area over time the thing I noticed most was that it seemed to plump up the skin around my eyes quite nicely! ! I feel like I look more well rested on the days that I use it.

I used this product as directed. I applied at night and in the morning on clean skin. The texture was nice. It was very easy to apply. I do not have issues with dark circles but it did soften the look of my undereye wrinkles. I did not have any sensitivity to this product. I would recommend this product to anyone! I was impressed!

I received Kiehl's Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum in exchange for my honest review. This eye serum has a creamy consistency that absorbs easily and plays well with makeup. I love that it's in a pump so you're not digging your fingers into a tub. I have noticed an instant smoothing effect in the under eye area when I apply this product. I'm in my 40s, and the skin around my eyes is showing signs of age. This serum moisturizes, softens and evens out the texture. I definitely recommend!

avis.titre: The good product for your eyes
avis.texte: I am over 30 years old and my eyes skin is old, wrinkles, and darker. And I am wondering to find a product that can help to improve those issues. I have tried this product 2 weeks then feeling my troubles are getting better. The structure is not too sticky, not too thick, easy get a small amount to apply around eyes. The size easy to pack for travelling.

I mainly used this serum/cream at night. It's very lightweight and a little goes a long way. The actual serum has a yellowish color to it, not white like the product marketing images show. I liked the texture of the product. It's feels velvety like a primer does. I felt that this product had a blurring effect that helped mask my dark circles a bit. I did not notice a reduction in lines around my eyes, but I've only been using this for a few weeks.

avis.titre: Best eye cream I've ever used (literally)
avis.texte: From the first time I used it I noticed a difference!! That has literally never happened before! I have spent hundreds if not thousands on eye creams and this is by far the best thing I've ever used. I put one tiny pump on my finger for each eye and pat it into my skin & IMMEDIATELY I see/feel the difference. It makes my skin feel soft, kind of like a blurring primer type of feeling. It has an orange/peach tint to it which I definitely think helps with the dark circles. (Peach concealer is supposed to help with dark circles) my eyes instantly looked better and in turn I instantly felt better! I will 100% be purchasing this before this bottle runs out. Also, it's pretty big for an eye cream. If you're hesitating - just do it! It's worth it!! I will not go a day without it!!!!

Hello I don't really suffer for dark circle under my eyes is only some times but let me tell you that this one done work only for the dark circles is hydrating and also had vitamin c a powerful antioxidant help with dark circles and with and also with wrinkles I love my under eye looks more a wake and glowing

avis.titre: I'm adding this miracle bottle to my routine
avis.texte: I received this as a promotional gift. This is a miracle in a bottle!!!!! This has really lightened up my dark circles . It's worth every dime you won't regret it

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: I have been using this over the past few weeks in place of my usual vitamin C serum. This product performs comparably without feeling as sticky or oily as the serum I used previously. It has the consistency and texture of a primer and glides om smoothly.

I have been using this serum for a couple weeks and feel a difference. I don't have very sensitive skin, so I wasn't concerned, but really happy with the results of brighter looking under eyes and feeling tighter around the eyes.

avis.titre: A good product with great packaging.
avis.texte: I'm really been enjoying this product lately. The thick consistency provides a lot of under eye hydration, but does not leave my skin greasy. I have been putting this on both day and night and then just apply a light moisturizer on top and I'm good to go. It is non-irritating and does help to reduce dark circles. I'm still left with some puffiness though, so I don't feel like it as much in that department. Overall, this is good and I enjoy the packaging.

avis.titre: Must have for every day regimen!
avis.texte: I love this product. After I wash my face, I put my under eye cream on and then apply this. It has been wonderful and I've seen a reduction in dark circles. This has definitely been added in to my every day routine.

I've been using this under eye serum for the last three weeks at night after I shower and I have noticed an actual difference! My under eyes are ALOT less purple! I will be purchasing this again and again!

avis.titre: Try it and see for yourself
avis.texte: I used for a week and it is nice. Good texture and light weight. I am sensitive and did not have a reaction. I will continue and see if it is worth purchasing when done with this bottle

Thank you Bzzagent for this free Kielh's Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum in exchange for an honest review. I've used serum for a couple of weeks under my eyes and have noticed a slight reduction in dark circles, nothing dramatic. It is a yellow serum so it can take a while to absorb into the skin, maybe don't use if your're rushing out the door.
The serum is a dry, thick, orange color instead of the creamy, white shown. A little bit goes a long way. It spreads and absorbs into the skin to disguise the lines and darkness around the eyes.

This product WORKS! I apply after washing my face every morning and every night. My eyes feel instantly hydrated. I have a toddler so naturally I have dark circles under my eyes and my mom even asked if I had been sleeping better because I don't look so tired! She's sold on this product too! I will purchase this once it's gone.
Kiehls Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum is very nice, it reduced my eye puffiness and starting to see my dark circles lighten

I'm absolutely loving the Line Reducing Dark Circles Diminished Eye Serum! I've been using it for a few weeks. The serum is lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly, making it perfect for daily use. My eyes look smoother, brighter, and more refreshed than ever before.

This serum has a nice texture; creamy but not heavy. It sinks in well into the eye area and leaves the skin nicely moisturized. I have been using for a couple of days with no noticeable change but I have yet to find an eye cream that does noticeably improve the area.

I have actually tried a lot of different vitamin C serums and honestly this is my favorite. I highly recommend the Kiehl's Powerful-Strength 10% Vitamin C Eye Serum to address multiple under eye concerns, such as fine lines, dark circles and puffiness. It took a few weeks to see a difference. But over time, my dark circles and puffiness started to disappear. The addition of hyaluronic acid is particularly effective in maintaining moisture without being too greasy or sticky. The texture and absorption of the product is great, it absorbs quickly without leaving any residue. This makes it suitable for use under makeup. I did notice, it has a slight tint. It is very gentle and soothing. It doesn't tingle for me. I have never had any allergic reactions to the product. The packaging is very convenient and hygienic, with a pump dispenser that helps me control the amount of product when using. Although the product is a bit expensive, I feel its effectiveness is worth the money spent.
I loved the consistency of the serum and even my daughter noticed a difference with my dark undereyes.

I love this eye serum. Kiehl's makes some of my favorite skincare products and this one is up there! It absorbs into the skin nicely and isn't too greasy like other eye serums I have tried in the past. It instantly brightens my under eyes and reduces the appearance of the line lines around my eyes. It helps with puffiness in the morning and helps get rid of that "tired" look. It is definitely the most effective eye product I have tried. I would highly recommend!

Kiehl's Powerful Strength Vitamin C Eye Serum is a game-changer for anyone looking to brighten their under-eye area. It sits beautifully under makeup, almost providing a blurring effect that smooths and preps the skin for a flawless application. The brightening properties of the serum are noticeable, giving a refreshed and revitalized look. Overall, it's a fantastic addition to any skincare routine, especially for those who wear makeup regularly.

I was so excited to try this product! I used it for a few days and it felt nice. However, I'm not sure if it was a coincidence or a reaction to the product but.....one night i went to bed and kept waking up because my left eye was hurting me on my lid and underneath my eye. I didnt see anything but when I touched it with the slightest bit of pressure, it was painful. Like the feeling you get when you have a black and blue and touch it. by the time i woke up in the morning, my lid was completely swollen, i had bumps in the corner on my skin (closest to my temple) and under my eye was swollen. Looked like someone punch me in the face and my eye ws half way closed. So, I dont know if something got in my eye or it was from the cream because my right eye was fine. I may have to try it again in a few weeks and if the same thing happens, i will know for sure it was from the product. However, right now, I cannot be certain but..my eye was fine before i started using this product and it was only after 3-4 days that this happened. so, I cannot recommend.

I've been using this product for a couple of weeks and I see a significant difference. My dark circles have lightened up a lot. Although it's not working as fast as I'd hoped, I'm encouraged by the results so far.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I was given the opportunity to try this product as a sample? in exchange for my review. I am very happy with it. It feels soft and luxurious going on and absorbs well. The look of the package and brand name are clearly for a premium product, and it shows by the way the serum looks and feels.

No matter how much I sleep my dark circles are so strong. I noticed the puffiness in my under eyes go down the first week and then after I noticed the pigment wasn't as visible. Love that it wasn't heavy nor was there a smell either. Glides right on the skin and a little is a lot.

This product has a nice consistency and goes on smoothly. It had a slight tingly feeling the first few times but I also have sensitive skin. I am someone who had always had dark circles and I have tried numerous different creams. Too many to count. I will say out of them all this one has been my favorite. I do think I naturally have dark circles but with this cream I have noticed a difference and I am wearing less concealer. My partner has noticed the difference as well. I would definitely recommend this product over many of the other options out there.

avis.titre: I would buy this product only for my travel bag
avis.texte: I was lucky enough to receive a free sample of this eye serum. I have used this product for a couple weeks now, and as a test, I was only putting it on one side. I would mostly include this in just my morning routine, to help with my darkening circles under my eyes, and occasionally with my nightly routine (the directions say twice a day). It definitely works! I can clearly see a difference during the day and overtime. So I am currently using it on both eyes now. Initially there is a nice warming feeling when you apply it, which I very much enjoy. A little goes a long way, so the product should last quite a while. My only small gripe about this serum is the stuff that gets stuck on the spout. If left there for too long, perhaps it could get nasty or even harden to the point of not working properly. Overall I really like this Kiehl's product. I like it because there is a lot of goodness packed into a small package that you can easily travel with. So I believe the price tag justifies the convenience, but its going in the travel bag. Not going to replace the other serums I use at home.

The Kielh's Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum is Ideal for all skin types even if you have sensitive skin which is one of the reasons that I love this product. It does help decrease the appearance of aging signs around the eye area that you can visibly see.

avis.titre: A new staple in my routine
avis.texte: I was a little shocked when I seen the price but honestly it is worth it! I'll be buying more. I started seeing results within a week and I'm not one to wear much makeup so taking care of these dark circles was a must. Plus a little goes a long way!
I've been using this every night for 4 nights in a row and I've noticed my under eye skin more tight and I'm excited to keep seeing results!!

I received this product for my honest review. After trying this product for a couple of day, mostly before bed, I haven't really noticed a change in my dark circles. This serum is very thick, and does not require much at all. The morning after using this, I felt my under eyes were very weighted down and heavy feeling, even after washing my face.

Kiehl's Powerful-Strength Dark Circle Reducing Vitamin C Eye Serum is a standout product in the realm of eye care. It's formulation, enriched with a potent blend of Vitamin C and hyaluronic acid, delivers noticeable improvements in reducing dark circles and puffiness. After using it consistently for a few weeks, I observed a marked brightening effect around my eyes and a smoother, more refreshed appearance. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly without leaving any residue, making it an excellent addition to my morning routine. Overall, it's a high-quality, effective serum!

I use this every morning as part of my skin care routine. I really enjoy the texture of this product it's nice and lightweight, a little goes a long way. The packaging is great keeps thing fresh and hygienic. This really helps brighten my dark circles and I see a difference in my fine lines.
The product delivers everything it promises. A strong lightening agent for dark circles, high level of hydration and reduction of fine lines under the eyes.

I didn't take any pictures because I really didn't expect this to make any difference in my tired-mom dark circles but WOW. Definite difference in color BUT I haven't noticed any change in my fine lines or wrinkles in the few weeks I've been using it. The feel is not my favorite - like oily silicone - but it applies easily, doesn't smell, and has done wonders for my dark undereyes so I can look past that.
